# Oscar Leo Photography

> Professional photography studio based in Vancouver, British Columbia, serving Metro Vancouver and available for commissions across Canada. Six services: headshots and portraits, event photography, brand photography and video, wedding photography, concert and live performance photography, and behind-the-scenes production photography. All pricing is published. All packages include professional editing and high-resolution delivery.

- **Location:** Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada
- **Areas served:** Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Surrey, Coquitlam, Delta, Langley, the wider Lower Mainland, British Columbia, and across Canada
- **Currency:** All prices in Canadian dollars (CAD), plus GST
- **Travel:** Included within 30 km of Vancouver; $75 flat fee for 30–60 km; beyond that quoted individually
- **Booking:** A 30% retainer reserves a date
- **Website:** https://oscarleo.photography/

## Services and pricing

### Headshots and portraits — from $395
https://oscarleo.photography/vancouver-headshot-photographer/
Corporate headshots, LinkedIn profile photos, personal branding portraits and team sessions, in studio or on location at a Vancouver office.
- Essential Headshot $395 — up to 45 minutes, 2 outfits, 3 retouched high-resolution images
- Personal Branding Portrait $595 — up to 90 minutes, multiple outfits, 6 retouched images
- Team and Corporate Headshots — $450 on-site setup fee, plus $185 per person for 5–9 people, $155 per person for 10–24 people, $135 per person for 25+ people; one retouched image per person; commercial licence included
- Delivery: five business days from final selection; 48-hour priority $95
- Add-ons: additional retouched image $65, additional location from $95, additional 30 minutes $150

### Event photography — from $500
https://oscarleo.photography/vancouver-event-photographer/
Documentary coverage of corporate events, conferences, product launches, award nights, galas, fundraisers, networking events, community and cultural events, and private celebrations.
- 2 hours $500 · 3 hours $720 · 4 hours $940 · 6 hours $1,380 · 8 hours $1,800
- Additional hours beyond eight: $215. Two-hour minimum booking.
- Effective rate: $250/hour at two hours, dropping to $225/hour at eight hours
- Output: approximately 40–60 finished photographs per hour
- Included: editing on every delivered image, high-resolution files, private online gallery, commercial digital licence for website, social media, press releases and internal communications
- Delivery: 3–5 business days; 48-hour priority gallery $150
- Add-ons: 1-minute vertical highlight video $250, second photographer $175/hour

### Brand photography and video — from $650
https://oscarleo.photography/vancouver-brand-photography-video/
Photography and short-form vertical video for Vancouver businesses, built for websites, social media and marketing.
- Brand Essential $650 — up to 90 minutes, one location, 25+ edited photographs
- Brand Photo + Video $950 — up to 2 hours, 40+ edited photographs, one edited vertical video up to 60 seconds
- Content Library $1,650 — up to 4 hours, up to 2 locations, 75+ edited photographs, two edited vertical videos
- Monthly Content Retainer from $1,200/month — one half-day session monthly, minimum 3 months
- Licensing: commercial digital-use licence for the client's own website, social media and standard marketing; copyright remains with the photographer; paid advertising and third-party licensing quoted separately
- Add-ons: additional hour $395, additional vertical video $250, 48-hour priority delivery $150, advanced retouching $95/hour

### Wedding photography — from $995
https://oscarleo.photography/vancouver-wedding-photographer/
Elopements through full-day coverage in Vancouver and across British Columbia.
- Elopement $995 — up to 2 hours, ceremony, couple portraits and immediate family
- Intimate $1,495 — up to 4 hours, adds wedding party, family, guests and venue
- Essential $2,195 — up to 6 hours, adds getting ready, details and early reception
- Signature $2,895 — up to 8 hours, adds speeches, cake cutting and first dance, plus a complimentary engagement session
- Full Story $3,595 — up to 10 hours, getting ready through evening dancing, engagement session and priority sneak peek
- All packages include a pre-wedding consultation, high-resolution and web-ready files, a private online gallery and personal printing rights

### Concert and live performance photography — from $450
https://oscarleo.photography/vancouver-concert-photographer/
Coverage for individual artists, bands, promoters, venues, showcases and festivals in Vancouver and across British Columbia.
- Live Performance $450 — up to 90 minutes, 50+ edited photographs, delivery in 3–5 business days
- Half-Day Performance $950 — up to 4 hours, multiple performers, 120+ edited photographs
- Full-Day Festival $1,800 — up to 8 hours, multiple artists, 150+ edited photographs
- Licensing: promotional licence for the commissioning artist, venue or promoter; label, publication, sponsor and advertising usage quoted separately
- Add-ons: additional hour $215, second photographer $175/hour, 48-hour priority selects $150

### Behind the scenes and unit stills — from $700
https://oscarleo.photography/vancouver-bts-unit-stills-photographer/
Production photography for film, television, music video, recording sessions, commercial shoots and advertising campaigns.
- BTS Half Day $700 — up to 4 consecutive hours
- BTS Full Day $1,200 — up to 8 consecutive hours
- BTS Full Day + Priority Selects $1,400 — full day plus 15–20 edited priority images within 24 hours
- Licensing: production-use licence covering EPK, press, social media and production marketing
- Add-ons: additional hour $175, 24-hour priority selection $175, advanced retouching $95/hour
- Travel and accommodation may apply outside the Vancouver area

## Approach

Documentary observation combined with thoughtful direction — guidance where it helps, genuine moments left alone. Polished photography that does not look staged.
